label: Avast Cleanup – Phone Cleaner
description_long:
**Avast Cleanup – Smart Phone Cleaner & Storage Manager**   
  
Avast Cleanup is a powerful phone cleaner and storage manager designed to help you remove junk files and perform deep cleaning on your Android device for an organized experience. With advanced cleaning tools and smart cleaning technology, Avast Cleanup turns your device into a cleaner phone. Whether you need to clean your phone, manage storage space, remove junk, or identify what drains your battery, Avast Cleanup delivers a complete cleaning experience.  
  
Go beyond simple storage management by identifying hidden, unnecessary files that slow down your device. Our advanced cleaning technology detects leftover data and temporary files from uninstalled apps that occupy valuable storage. By removing these digital leftovers, you get more than a better organized phone — you reclaim space for new photos, videos, and important applications.   
  
Get more from your device with our intelligent cleaning features. Avast Cleanup doesn't just delete files; App Analyzer helps you identify apps that are active in the background, so you can manage them more easily.   
  
Organize your media and gallery with our smart photo cleaning feature. We help you identify blurry, poor-quality, or duplicate photos. From managing large files to organizing your downloads, Avast Cleanup is the all-in-one app to keep your phone clean.   
  
**Avast Cleanup Features**   
  
**Clean and Remove**   
• Remove unnecessary files and safely clean junk.  
• Clean junk files, browser history, download folders, leftover data, and more.  
  
**Reclaim Storage Space**   
• Analyze storage space.   
• Quickly and easily uninstall multiple unwanted apps in one go.  
• Clear junk, including old and residual files.   
  
**Analyze App Impact**   
• Determine the impact of individual apps on your device.   
• Check which apps consume your data.   
• Find apps draining your battery.   
• Discover unused apps with Apps Overview.   
  
**Clean your photo library**   
• Find and remove similar, old, and poor-quality (dark or blurry) images.   
• Use the photo adjuster feature to reduce photo sizes with Low, Moderate, High, and Aggressive file compression   
• Delete photos from private chats   
  
**Monitor system resources**   
• Learn how your CPU (processor), RAM, and storage are used so you can quickly spot issues and keep your device running smoothly.   
  
**Easy to Use**   
• Clean your Android with our Quick Clean   
• Simple, intuitive user interface which is easy to navigate.   
  
**Summary**   
► App Analyzer: Identify apps draining resources and easily clean up with Avast Cleanup.   
► App Remover: Quickly clear out unused apps to increase storage space.   
► Junk Cleaner: Master the cleanup of junk files and residual app and browser data.   
► Analyze apps based on storage, battery use, and data consumption to decide what to clear or clean up.   
► Detect and remove duplicate photos for effective cleaning.   
► Easily clean up your photo library and clear unnecessary files.   
► With one tap, clean your phone, perform a full cleanup, and clear junk files in seconds.   
► Organize photos easily.   
  
By installing this app, you agree that your use of it is governed by these terms: https://www.avast.com/en-ph/cybersec-event-terms.   
  
Avast Cleanup uses accessibility permission to assist disabled and other users stop background apps with just one tap.   
  
**_Download Avast Cleanup – the smart, powerful phone cleaner and cleaner app to keep your Android device tidy by removing junk, managing storage, and completing thorough cleanup today._**
